key_findings: **8 base classes ENUMERATED** - all in Sqwt namespace (1 in Sqwt::Media sub-namespace).

**WPF ARCHITECTURE CONFIRMED**: The Sqwt UI framework is structurally Windows Presentation Foundation. Identical layered model: DependencyObject <- Visual <- UIElement with IInputElement secondary interface. WPF's namespace mapping: System.Windows.DependencyObject, System.Windows.Media.Visual, System.Windows.UIElement, System.Windows.IInputElement. SQEX appears to have hand-rolled a WPF-shaped UI framework in C++ for their FFXIV client.
**+0xB4 MYSTERY ANCHOR CLOSED**: The +0xB4 secondary vftable observed in derived Sqwt UI classes is `Sqwt::InputElement::vftable` (BCS-Y-1377). This was an unidentified anchor; now resolved.

**Sqwt has its OWN AllocatorBase** (distinct from Component::Lua::GameEngine::LgeBase). Two parallel memory-allocator hierarchies: one for the Lua-bridge, one for the Sqwt UI framework. The SQEX engine designs per-subsystem allocator policies.
